findings.summary: دکھائے is the masculine-plural past; the object ڈیوائسز is feminine plural in the shipped corpus («ڈیوائسز ہوتی ہیں», «… صاف ہو جائیں گی»), so this is the one value in the 182 that disagrees with its object. The correct short form دکھائیں is byte-identical to the آپ imperative (56/56 shipped occurrences are imperatives), so the fix moves to the فہرست بنائی family: 22/24 cells, unambiguous, correct agreement, 2 keys because the en sidecar requires the pair to share a verb. F-01's register defect is fixed; its prescription was not.
